# OGIFT - Onati Global Institute of Fashion Technology

> India's first AI-powered multilingual online fashion design institute, 
> based in Bangalore. Courses available in Hindi, English and Kannada.

## About
Onati Global Institute of Fashion Technology (OGIFT) is an online fashion 
design institute based in Bangalore, India. The platform uses conversational 
AI agents, an AI Portfolio Builder, and a Virtual Fashion Counsellor to 
deliver personalised fashion training.

## Courses
- Fashion Illustration: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/fashion-illustration
- Pattern Making Basic: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/pattern-making-basic
- Draping Technology: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/draping-technology
- Fashion Styling: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/fashion-styling
- 6-Month Diploma in Fashion Designing: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/six-months-diploma-fashion-designing
- 1-Year Advanced Diploma: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/one-year-advanced-diploma-fashion-designing
- 3-Month Online Fashion Course: https://www.ogiftbangalore.com/courses/3-months-online-fashion-course

## Key Features
- Conversational AI agents for personalised learning
- AI Portfolio Builder with expert feedback
- Virtual Fashion Counsellor available 24/7
- Multilingual: Hindi, English and Kannada
- 100% placement assistance
- Located in Vinayakanagar, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
